steps.en: Install Airflow pinned to a constraints file for a reproducible env
steps.zh: 用官方 constraints 文件锁定依赖，可复现地安装 Airflow

steps.en: Start a full local instance with one command
steps.zh: 一条命令启动完整的本地实例

steps.en: Initializes the metadata DB, creates an admin, runs scheduler, API server, DAG processor
steps.zh: 初始化元数据库、建管理员，并启动所有组件

steps.en: Write each pipeline as a Python DAG file of tasks and dependencies
steps.zh: 把流水线写成 Python DAG 文件：任务与依赖

steps.en: Open the UI and unpause the DAG
steps.zh: 打开 Web UI，解除 DAG 暂停

steps.en: On schedule, hands ready tasks to your executor, records every run, retries and backfills
steps.zh: 按调度把就绪任务交给执行器，记录每次运行，负责重试与回填

value.en: Scheduled batch pipelines as version-controlled code, with retries, backfills and one team-wide UI
value.zh: 批处理流水线变成进版本库的代码，自带重试、回填和一个全团队共用的 UI
